verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Templates", which shows it ships a saved-template capability. The pack contains only the article title, so how deep that capability goes is unknown. missing for 10: any description of how templates are inserted during compose, support for variables/placeholders, support for attachments in templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
